main.remarks: Provides a simple thumbprint-oriented in-memory material store.

field.name: sync
field.summary: Synchronization gate protecting current signing material and registered verification material updates.

field.name: currentsigningmaterial
field.summary: Currently selected signing material used when signing resolution succeeds.

field.name: verificationmaterials
field.summary: Registered verification material indexed by canonical signer key-identifier strings.

method.name: TryAddVerificationMaterial
method.summary: Try to register verification material for later resolution.
method.returns: True when the verification material was stored; otherwise false.

method.name: TryClearCurrentSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to clear the current signing material selection.
method.returns: True when a current signing material selection existed and was cleared; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetCurrentSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to get the current signing material selection.
method.returns: True when current signing material is configured; otherwise false.

method.name: TryRemoveVerificationMaterial
method.summary: Try to remove verification material associated with a specific signer key identifier.
method.param: Format discriminator for the signer key identifier to remove.
Signer key identifier bytes associated with the verification material to remove.
method.returns: True when matching verification material was removed; otherwise false.

method.name: TryResolveSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to resolve signing material for the current signing operation.
method.param: Signing context for the current operation.
method.returns: True when signing material was resolved; otherwise false.

method.name: TryResolveVerificationMaterial
method.summary: Try to resolve verification material for the current validation operation.
method.param: Validation context for the current operation.
method.returns: True when verification material was resolved; otherwise false.

method.name: TrySetCurrentSigningMaterial
method.summary: Try to set the current signing material selection.
method.param: Signing material to use for future signing operations.
method.returns: True when the current signing material selection was updated; otherwise false.

method.name: CreateVerificationKey
method.summary: Create the canonical dictionary key used to store or resolve verification material by signer key identifier.
method.param: Format discriminator for the signer key identifier.
method.returns: Canonical dictionary key, or null when the signer key identifier is empty.

method.name: NormalizeThumbprint
method.summary: Normalize a certificate thumbprint into the canonical uppercase no-space form used by the in-memory store.
method.param: Certificate associated with the material being normalized.
Explicit thumbprint override, or null to fall back to the certificate thumbprint.
method.returns: Canonical thumbprint, or null when no usable thumbprint is available.

method.name: TryNormalizeSigningMaterial
method.summary: Normalize signing material into the canonical thumbprint-based shape used by the store.
method.returns: True when the signing material could be normalized; otherwise false.

method.name: TryNormalizeVerificationMaterial
method.summary: Normalize verification material into the canonical thumbprint-based shape used by the store and produce its dictionary key.
method.param: Canonical dictionary key for the normalized verification material.
method.returns: True when the verification material could be normalized; otherwise false.
